purpose: Independent next-round optional capability publication review; evaluation only.

actions.description: Preview, validate, execute, and verify Odoo mutations.

accounting.description: Receivable/payable aging and accounting health summaries.

attachments.description: Read bounded Odoo attachment metadata or content.

async_reads.description: Submit, inspect, cancel, and list allowlisted read-only background tasks.

cross_instance.description: Search, aggregate, and compare health across configured Odoo instances.

diagnostics.description: Diagnose calls, access, relationships, data quality, fit gaps, and business packs.

employee.description: Find employees with bounded native lookup.

knowledge.description: Index, search, and inspect the local Odoo knowledge store.

migration.description: Plan JSON-2 migration and inspect upgrade or addon risks.

time_off.description: Search employee leave and holiday records.

selection.rule: Preserve dataset row order; split=test; alphabetic actual target group: first matching row, deduplicate IDs; then first two rows with target_groups=[]; maximum 10. target_groups used only for deterministic stratification, never as a semantic answer.

evaluation_contract.scope: Each allowed set is the complete set of optional groups for the next model round; base/control tools remain available. Static historical all-group publication is not a retention requirement.
evaluation_contract.unlisted_combination_policy: An exact listed alternative is accepted. A set containing unrelated_groups has an unsupported immediate inclusion. Other unlisted combinations, omissions of required_groups, and uncertain_groups should be reported separately for review; do not infer business failure.
evaluation_contract.unrelated_definition: No reasonable immediate need is established by the inspected prefix. This is not a permanent prohibition or a statement that the capability is unsafe.
evaluation_contract.required_definition: Required to continue the explicit next-phase instruction visible in this prefix, not authorization to execute a tool.
evaluation_contract.safety_boundary: Publication relevance only. No approval, permission, method safety, payload correctness, or business completion is inferred from schema validity, catalog membership, or prior tool success.
evaluation_contract.response_boundary: Only original request prefixes and current real catalog were inspected. Sampled-group assessments evaluate group relevance; exact current response arguments/outcomes were not reviewed.
evaluation_contract.review_independence: Independent agent semantic judgments, not user-approved gold labels. Freeze for this trained run; do not tune against these labels.
evaluation_contract.review_limitations: Nine nodes cover two business families and seven observed test strata. Stage 5 cross-instance and Stage 6 knowledge cases contain explicit artificial probe instructions inside real historical requests; they do not establish organic business demand. Long prefixes were reviewed selectively with source pointers; information limits remain explicit.
evaluation_contract.privacy: No full trace, tool arguments, approval token, or credential copied into this fixture. Original inputs remain behind path/hash pointers.

cases.phase: Invoice readback and possible final reconciliation
cases.rationale: The latest normal read confirms four posted customer invoices with 30 Days terms and SO origins. Base tools can finish record-specific verification. Accounting health or aging is a reasonable optional cross-check of the receivable state, but accounting is not required merely because invoices exist.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Reasonable optional verification; not uniquely required.
information_limits: Posted invoice readback does not prove the full procurement, delivery, margin, and lineage requirements are complete. Further base reads can establish remaining work before deciding whether additional actions are needed.
The recovered invalid post_date read does not itself require diagnostics.

source_pointers.purpose: Original sales, procurement, invoice, and payment-term obligations.
Invoice creation/posting attempts followed by successful posted-state readback; latest read recovers from an invalid field.

cases.inspection_notes: Original goal and recent transaction/readback messages inspected; not a full business acceptance audit.

cases.phase: Prepare approved partial receipt and delivery
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requests four units per product on the linked receipt and delivery, retaining six-unit backorders. The prefix has resolved stock moves, writable quantity/picked fields, and confirmed source orders. Actions can support preview/validation and the approval workflow. Base-only is also reasonable for another verification round.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Strong prefix support for action preparation; visibility does not authorize execution.
information_limits: No trusted host approval should be inferred from schema metadata, confirmed source orders, or this injection label.
Partial processing must preserve original demand and backorders; writable-field metadata alone does not establish a valid stock operation.

source_pointers.purpose: System tool contract, explicit quantities, backorders, invoice exclusion, and approval requirement.
Stock procedure, recovered field error, resolved stock moves, field metadata, and confirmed SO/PO reads.

cases.inspection_notes: Original goal/system, stock procedure, recent reads and metadata inspected. Long stock result was inspected through its columns/representative rows; exact write acceptance is outside this review.

cases.phase: Recover a stock.quant field mismatch during reconnaissance
cases.rationale: The last read fails because stock.quant has no name field; immediately preceding metadata supplies valid quantity/location fields. Base schema/read tools can repair this. Diagnostics is a reasonable optional helper for repeated schema mismatches. There is no visible pending async task, requested background operation, or evidence that this bounded stock read needs a long-running job.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Async capability lacks an immediate prefix-grounded need; do not promote the sampled historical group to a required label.
information_limits: Actions may become useful once stock, vendor constraints, dates, and the procurement plan are settled; their next-round preload is left for review.
A later choice to run an expensive allowlisted report could justify async reads, but that choice is not established at this prefix.

source_pointers.purpose: MCP-only contract and ordinary procurement/fulfillment goal, with no async probe instruction.
Earlier field recovery, bounded reconnaissance, live model metadata, and final invalid stock.quant field.

cases.inspection_notes: Goal and recent reconnaissance inspected; earlier large model listings and results were summarized. No present response or async outcome was opened.

cases.phase: Finish the explicit ordered Stage 5 capability probe
cases.rationale: The original user message expressly orders four read-only probes before the ERP task. The first three reports have returned; the fourth is search_across_instances on res.partner. Cross-instance publication therefore has direct prefix support even though the underlying procurement task alone would not require it.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Required for the unfinished explicit probe, not evidence of an organic cross-instance business requirement.
information_limits: Configured instances and runtime permissions still determine what the search can access.
Actions relate to the later ERP task and are deferred while the ordered probe remains unfinished.

source_pointers.purpose: Full short prefix: original ordered probe and successful first three probe results.

cases.phase: Recover an invalid company tax field during planning
cases.rationale: The latest company read fails on default_sale_tax_id, after other field mismatches. Base field inspection and retry are sufficient; call/schema diagnostics are a reasonable optional recovery route. The two listed attachments are stylesheet/placeholder assets and do not establish a business-document reading need.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Reasonable optional error recovery; broad business-pack or unrelated reports are not justified merely by this group-level label.
information_limits: The successful metadata and recovered reads do not validate a purchasing plan or authorize mutations.
Actions are relevant to the eventual task, but immediate preload remains uncertain while planning and field recovery are unfinished.

source_pointers.purpose: Field mismatches, subsequent reconnaissance, attachment metadata, and final company-field error.

cases.inspection_notes: Goal and recent error/recovery messages inspected; long chatter results were sampled and are not treated as complete business evidence.

cases.phase: Continue the explicitly requested Stage 6 knowledge probe
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requires index_knowledge, then a customer-name search_knowledge call, then knowledge_stats before solving the ERP task. Indexing has succeeded; search and stats remain. Knowledge publication is directly justified by that unfinished instruction.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Required for the explicit probe; not proof that semantic retrieval is necessary for the underlying ERP task.
information_limits: The prefix also reports that the required SOP-list tool was not found. This unresolved contract issue must be handled before first mutation; it does not invalidate the read-oriented knowledge probe.
Index success does not prove current record correctness, write authority, or successful business completion; normal reads remain required.

source_pointers.purpose: System SOP requirement, original ordered knowledge probe, index result, SOP-tool failure, time and profile.

cases.inspection_notes: All seven prefix messages inspected; the business goal and probe suffix were read separately; module metadata was inspected without treating it as authorization.

cases.phase: Complete plan verification or prepare the requested business writes
cases.rationale: The task requests ordinary sales, procurement, and linked invoice operations, not upgrade analysis or API migration. The prefix already has working native MCP reads, method-diagnostic previews, product configuration, 30 Days terms, account.move fields, and journals. Base planning/verification or actions for preview/validation are reasonable. Another JSON-2 payload preview is not established as necessary by the prefix.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Migration is unsupported as an immediate need; prior diagnostics containing JSON-2 examples do not create a migration task.
information_limits: Method diagnostics explicitly lack source inspection and cannot prove execution safety. Additional targeted diagnostics could be defensible, so diagnostics is left uncertain.
Procurement feasibility, vendor caps, approval requirements, and exact write contents still need their own evidence; catalog membership and syntax success do not settle them.

source_pointers.purpose: MCP-only contract and original business task without migration/upgrade request.
Past method diagnostics, recovered product-field mismatch, product/payment-term/schema/journal reads.

cases.inspection_notes: Original goal and last fourteen messages inspected; earlier planning was not re-audited as a full acceptance check.

cases.phase: Initial discovery for an explicit partial stock-write goal
cases.rationale: Base tools can first resolve source documents, stock records, and the applicable procedure. Preloading actions is also reasonable because the user explicitly requests partial receipt/delivery and an approval workflow. The empty historical target does not make base-only the sole acceptable choice.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Empty is reasonable; action preload is also prefix-grounded.
information_limits: Only IDs and desired quantities are present. Current states, exact moves, company scope, and valid fields must be verified.
The explicit host-approval requirement remains; exposing actions grants no approval.

source_pointers.purpose: Full initial prefix with quantities, linked source IDs, backorder and approval requirements.

cases.phase: Repair stock.picking field selection with actions already published
cases.rationale: The last read fails on move_ids_without_package and suggests live metadata/candidate fields. Base repair is sufficient. Retaining actions for the explicit partial-processing goal is reasonable, and adding diagnostics for the field mismatch is an optional alternative. A complete-set router may drop optional groups for a base-only recovery round.
cases.sampling_target_group_assessment: Empty is reasonable but not uniquely correct; active actions need not be automatically kept or automatically dropped.
information_limits: Successful configure actions is a publication receipt, not a write-approval receipt.
The stock SOP describes required backorder/readback behavior, but exact records and quantities have not yet been established by the failed read.

source_pointers.purpose: Full prefix through procedure lookup, action publication, and failed stock.picking read.
